correctness.rationale: Any outer vertex has degree r<=Q-2 and can never be forced, so each successful seed colors all rm outer vertices. If hub also colored, full proper coloring count Q((Q-1)_r)^m. If blank, its neighbors must display exactly Q-1 colors, leaving a unique legal hub color; inclusion-exclusion over missing t allowed colors gives Q S_(r,m)(t). This count is positive iff r<=t<=rm by capacity and explicit covering construction; r+2<=Q gives the claimed palette threshold, including m=1 where the first regime is empty. For fixed r,j, probability that a specified j-subset of t colors is unused equals [((t-j)_r)/(t_r)]^m and tends to t^(-j)e^(-jc), so finite Bonferroni truncations squeeze to exp(-e^-c). Independently enumerated all local compulsory-colour assignments on five small r,m,Q cases and obtained exactly matching polynomials.
residual_risks: Independent finite verification corroborates but cannot establish the all-parameter proof.
